findings.finding: STANDARD_DISPLACED_DESCENDANT is underspecified. Using a forward-shifted plotted Senkou value at the current bar can accidentally read information unavailable at signal time.
findings.required_change: Define displaced cloud causally from values computed 26 bars earlier, never by negative shift/future indexing.

findings.finding: Warm-up and prior-cross requirements are not explicit for each period combination.
findings.required_change: Require max(fast,slow,cloud_b,volatility/spread/tick lookback)+1 completed bars before eligibility.

findings.finding: Equality handling at Tenkan/Kijun and cloud boundaries is unspecified.
findings.required_change: Freeze strict cross definitions and strict/weak cloud-location alternatives as separate identities.

findings.finding: Several period combinations can collapse to identical masks or impossible parameter orderings.
findings.required_change: Preregister deterministic constraints and exact-mask deduplication before multiplicity counting.

findings.finding: Rolling highs/lows across long market closures can contaminate cross timing.
findings.required_change: Add reset/carry policies across proven data gaps as explicitly tagged descendants; do not silently bridge closures.

findings.finding: MID feature construction with crossed or zero spread ticks is underspecified.
findings.required_change: Preserve observed quotes; exclude crossed quotes from feature construction unless a dedicated descendant is preregistered; zero spread may be observed but cannot create artificial fills.

findings.finding: G31 may correlate with G29 because both encode trend continuation.
findings.required_change: Treat G31 as scientifically distinct at research stage but require event overlap/correlation and marginal contribution tests before portfolio risk allocation.
